acquisition_method.evidence: Data dependent MS/MS analysis was performed in top speed mode with a 2 sec. cycle time

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Briefly, the pellets were lysed, reduced, alkylated in a single step using a buffer containing 2% (w/v) SDC (sodium deoxycholate), 10 mM TCEP (Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride), 40 mM CAA (chloroacetamide), 100 mM Tris HCl pH 8.0, and loaded into StageTip.

cleavage_agent.evidence: The lysates were diluted with 25 mM Tris pH 8.5 containing 1 µg of trypsin.

collision_energy.evidence: HCD was performed using 28% normalized collision energy.

fragmentation_method.evidence: HCD was performed using 28% normalized collision energy.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: Samples were loaded from the sample loop directly into a 75-μm ID × 50 cm 2 μm, 100 Å C18 column mounted in the thermostated column compartment and the peptides were separated with increasing organic solvent at a flow rate of 250 nl/min using a non-linear gradient of 5–45% solution B (80% CAN and 20% H2O, 5% DMSO, 0.1% FA) in 180 min.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Eluting peptides were analyzed using an Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid mass spectrometer (ThermoFisher Scientific).
